_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
A le afi Klondike Solitaire. Ɖo kple nuwo kata ƒe nukpɔsɔ kple dzidziŋu siwo le foundation piles me.

Ɖo ƒe Seɖo:
- Foundation piles (F1-F4): Dzi kpɔ dzidziŋu tso Ace va ɖo King ƒe dzidziŋu me
- Tableau piles (T1-T7): Dzi kpɔ dzidziŋu tso dzidziŋu gãwo dome ƒe dzidziŋu me (dzidziŋu ƒomevi le dzidziŋu ƒomewo dzi)
- Stock: Dzo dzidziŋu siwo le waste pile me
- Waste (W): Dzidziŋu si kplɔe le dzidziŋu siwo le waste pile me

Ɖo ƒe Ɖɔɖɔɖo:
- 'draw' - Dzo dzidziŋu siwo le stock ƒe dzidziŋu me
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Dzi dzidziŋu siwo le dzidziŋu siwo ƒe dome
  Nya sia: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count hã sɔ kple 'all', si ƒe wɔwɔ dzidziŋu siwo kplɔe le dzidziŋu siwo ƒe dome.
- 'forfeit' - Ɖo ƒe ŋgɔ kpɔkpɔ kple dzidziŋu siwo hã
- Dzidziŋu siwo ƒe ŋkɔ: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

Aƒeme a le afi dzidziŋu siwo kple dzidziŋu siwo dome ƒe dzidziŋu siwo ƒe dzidziŋu siwo hã.
Ɖo ƒe dzidziŋu siwo hã dzidziŋu siwo ƒe dzidziŋu siwo ƒe dzidziŋu siwo hã - aƒeme a ƒe dzidziŋu siwo ƒe dzidziŋu siwo hã, dzidziŋu siwo hã dzidziŋu siwo ƒe dzidziŋu siwo ƒe dzidziŋu siwo hã.
Aƒeme a le afi 'forfeit' aƒe dzidziŋu siwo hã dzidziŋu siwo ƒe dzidziŋu siwo hã.

format_error.no_brackets: Dɔwɔɖui si mesɔ o. Ele be woawɔ dɔ le akplo me.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Dɔwɔŋutise si mesɔ o. Nuwuƒokpe mele eme ']'
format_error.empty_action: Dɔwɔɖui si me womezã naneke le o
format_error.move_needs_args: Move ɖoɖo ƒe xexlẽ si source alo destination. Usage: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Count ƒe xexlẽ si positive alo 'all'
format_error.count_invalid: Ɖo ƒe dzidziŋu siwo hã mekpɔe o. Aƒeme a le afi dzidziŋu siwo hã alo 'all'
format_error.unknown_command: Ɖɔɖɔɖo si mekpɔe o '{cmd}'. Aƒeme a le afi 'draw', 'move <source> <destination> [count]', alo 'forfeit'
